From 584a327c5cffc36369b2a8953d9448826240f1ac Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Krzysztof Kozlowski <krzysztof.kozlowski@linaro.org>
Date: Mon, 8 Jan 2024 14:12:15 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] arm64: dts: qcom: sdm845-db845c: correct PCIe wake-gpios

Bindings allow a "wake", not "enable", GPIO.  Schematics also use WAKE
name for the pin:

  sdm845-db845c.dtb: pcie@1c00000: Unevaluated properties are not allowed ('enable-gpio' was unexpected)

Fixes: 4a657c264b78 ("arm64: dts: qcom: db845c: Enable PCIe controllers")
Signed-off-by: Krzysztof Kozlowski <krzysztof.kozlowski@linaro.org>
Reviewed-by: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240108131216.53867-1-krzysztof.kozlowski@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Bjorn Andersson <andersson@kernel.org>

diff --git a/arch/arm64/boot/dts/qcom/sdm845-db845c.dts b/arch/arm64/boot/dts/qcom/sdm845-db845c.dts
index ab6220456513..1f517328199b 100644
--- a/arch/arm64/boot/dts/qcom/sdm845-db845c.dts
+++ b/arch/arm64/boot/dts/qcom/sdm845-db845c.dts
@@ -580,7 +580,7 @@ &mss_pil {
 &pcie0 {
 	status = "okay";
 	perst-gpios = <&tlmm 35 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>;
-	enable-gpio = <&tlmm 134 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
+	wake-gpios = <&tlmm 134 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
 
 	vddpe-3v3-supply = <&pcie0_3p3v_dual>;
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm64/boot/dts/qcom/sdm845-db845c.dts`**
   - The property `enable-gpio` was removed.
   - The property `wake-gpios` was added with the same GPIO configuration that was previously associated with `enable-gpio`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in the device tree source file (`sdm845-db845c.dts`) corrects the GPIO property used for PCIe wake functionality. The change from `enable-gpio` to `wake-gpios` aligns the device tree with the expected bindings, as the schematics indicate that the pin should be referred to as a "wake" GPIO rather than an "enable" GPIO. This fix addresses a validation error regarding unexpected properties in the device tree, ensuring compliance with the defined bindings.

arm64: dts: qcom: sdm845-db845c: correct PCIe wake-gpios

  sdm845-db845c.dtb: pcie@1c00000: Unevaluated properties are not allowed ('enable-gpio' was unexpected)

Fixes: 4a657c264b78 ("arm64: dts: qcom: db845c: Enable PCIe controllers")
Signed-off-by: Krzysztof Kozlowski <krzysztof.kozlowski@linaro.org>
Reviewed-by: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240108131216.53867-1-krzysztof.kozlowski@linaro.org

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect use of the `enable-gpio` property instead of the correct `wake-gpios` property in the device tree source file. This mismatch led to validation errors, as the bindings specified that a "wake" GPIO should be used, not an "enable" GPIO, which was not recognized by the system.
